title: Most Bundesliga games since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most Bundesliga appearances from 2000/01 to 2025/26.

notes.Marco Reus: Marco Reus is 11th with 391, just outside.
notes.Philipp Lahm: Philipp Lahm is 12th with 385, just outside.
notes.Makoto Hasebe: Makoto Hasebe is joint 13th with 384, just outside.

sources: Transfermarkt club season stats pages, every Bundesliga club 2000/01 to 2025/26 (players.csv, source column)
checks: Transfermarkt figures summed by Transfermarkt player id from every club season page. Second source: each player's Wikipedia career statistics table, Bundesliga rows from 2000/01 to 2025/26, which agree season by season with Transfermarkt for every player listed and every near miss (no differences, so no split figures). Transfermarkt's game-by-game records (ceapi performance-game) also give the same totals. Pizarro's 25 games for Werder Bremen in 1999/00 are left out (490 in all). Hasebe and Lewandowski are tied 13th on 384.
